entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Please be aware that this call may be recorded for quality assurance. To connect with a support agent, please press one.
Ugh, finally. Yes, an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's just not what I thought it would be. The order number is VF789012.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. One moment while I pull up order VF789012... Yes, I see it here. The VeloBand Pulse. Let me just check the delivery date...
Okay, sir, I'm seeing that the item was delivered to you 11 days ago.
And? So? I want to return it. Send me a label.
I understand, but our policy for the VeloBand Pulse has a strict 10-day return window. Since it's been 11 days, the system has automatically locked the order and I'm unable to process a return.
Are you serious right now? One day? You're going to deny my return over a single day? That's an absolutely ridiculous policy. I just want my money back!
I do understand your frustration, and I agree the timing is very close. Unfortunately, the policy is firm on that specific product due to the electronic components.
This is unbelievable. I want to speak to a manager. This is not acceptable.
Look... I'm not supposed to do this. The system is pretty clear and honestly, my **manager would kill me** if she saw me doing this.
Doing what? Your job?

No, sir. I'm going to try to... well, I'm going to try and **override the system** for you. Since it's only one day, I might be able to manually push it through. Please understand, this would absolutely have to be a **one-time exception**.
Wait, really? You can do that?
Let me see... Just give me one moment here... a few clicks... Okay. It looks like it worked. I've processed the return authorization for you.
Wow. Okay. So I'll get a label?

Yes. A prepaid return label is on its way to your email address on file right now. Just print it out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop it off. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
Oh, man. Thank you. Seriously, thank you so much. I was about to lose my mind. I really appreciate you doing that.
It's no problem at all. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. You've been a huge help. Thanks again, Alex.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
